notes.title: New Update (v1.05)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We just released an ENCHANTING new update based on all the feedback we've been receiving since our launch last month.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28976377/b007588ce4f39e0426d5fc66f75bec2535b5eefe.jpg[/img]

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]
[list][*] Steam achievements now working!
[*] Difficulty adjustments for specific levels
[*] Earn power-ups for replaying completed levels
[*] New Advanced Options in Settings:
- Additional resolution sizes, including Windowed and Borderless Fullscreen modes
- Toggle autorun / automatically finishing a level
- Enable tutorial instructions when replaying some levels
- Option to reset game progress
[*] Miscellaneous localization changes, UI improvements, and bug fixes[/list]
We're still working on the other reported issues, and we thank you for your patience. For comments and suggestions, drop by our [url=https://discord.gg/VQPuk7N]Discord server[/url] or email us at rescuequest@boomzap.com.

Thanks for playing!
-Boomzap team

notes.title: WE ARE LIVE!
notes.content:
Boom and Zap are finally here on Steam in the remastered version of our hit match-3 game! Rescue Quest Gold is now available for PC and Mac in 16 languages!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28976377/b007588ce4f39e0426d5fc66f75bec2535b5eefe.jpg[/img]

We are also giving away free copies of the game to three (3) winners here: http://rescuequest.boomzap.com/giveaway

This Steam release is a SPECIAL EDITION with additional features such as exclusive expert levels, wallpapers, concept art, and downloadable soundtrack. Steam Trading Cards are also available!

More info about the game here:
http://rescuequest.boomzap.com/gold

Check out the trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NTUVqBnd-fg
If you like our game, please do leave us a review. If you need help, we'll be around in the forums or you can also visit our Discord: https://discord.gg/VQPuk7N

Thank you everyone! Hope you have a great adventure in the world of Rescue Quest Gold!

-Boomzap team
